parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The start time of the subinterval. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query statement. Only query statements are supported. Analytic statements are not supported. For more information about the query syntax, see [Query syntax](~~43772~~).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The end time of the subinterval. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
